key_insight: The paper builds a large spin-polarized database for 2,500+ stable halide double perovskites, revealing many compositions with visible-range gaps and a notable set of half-metallic candidates.
engineering_relevance: This dataset accelerates materials screening for photovoltaics, photocatalysis, and spintronic or magnetic device design by linking composition to electronic structure and bonding.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT calculations of spin-polarized density of states for Cs2BB'X6 compounds (X = I, Br, Cl, F).
Chemical-bonding analysis with LOBSTER to interpret orbital interactions.
UMAP visualizations plus an interactive app for exploring composition, band structure, and magnetic properties.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports >2,500 compounds, including 719 with visible-range band gaps and 118 half-metallic materials, with electronic-structure data and bonding analysis provided.
watch_item: The database is prediction-driven and focused on thermodynamically stable candidates, so experimental validation is still needed before device deployment.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
